pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ H cải tiến: hai chân nghiêng vào trên mặt cầu, dầm ngang trên có vòm, hai cột đứng ở đỉnh; chân choãi dưới mặt cầu, dầm ngang đỡ dầm; cao 143,9 m từ đỉnh bệ móng (≈150 m)
pylons_en: 2 'improved H' pylons: legs lean inward above the deck to an arched upper crossbeam and two vertical posts; splayed feet with a deep under-deck beam; 143.9 m above the foundation top (≈150 m)

pylon_custom.description: Improved H (Vàm Cống): below the deck two straight legs splay outward from a large pile cap to a knee just under the deck, joined by a deep under-deck crossbeam with a haunched, slightly arched soffit; above the deck the legs lean inward (≈7° from vertical) to a single upper crossbeam with a round-arched soffit at ≈0.75 of the above-deck height, then continue as two vertical posts ≈11.5 m apart to flat tops. Stays in two inclined planes from the legs/posts to the edge girders.

model3d.notes: r9: Spans 210 + 450 + 210, no auxiliary piers (design paper: intermediate pier eliminated). Pylon 143.9 m above the foundation top (Lee & Kang 2013 / TEDI); 147 m drawn from the water with the cap ≈3 m proud; press '150 m' is probably from the cap underside. 144 stays = 18 per side per plane. Composite girder (2.0 m edge girders, 12 m segments), 24.5 m deck, clearance 37.5 m. Deck level estimated from photos (≈39 m above water at the pylons, 41.5 m at mid-span).

review: r9: near-vertical legs with a thin beam under the tip read as a plain rectangle frame, not the 'improved H'
